test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting anticlockwise in the same sequence around a circular table at equal distances facing the centre. Then, C and H interchange their places. If B is sitting in the south direction, in which direction is H facing now?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** **Given, B is sitting in the South, so Make the arrangement according to this, Take B as in South Direction and put the remaining friends in an Anticlockwise (Reverse) Direction.**

From the given information, we place them anticlockwise in the same sequence around a circular table at equal distances facing the centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21e2fa1585a17522f9fed0232782806dc42578550b372e01bbeaec7a8edf3746.png] Reverse order anticlockwise=Forward order clockwise

Now we interchange C and H, with B sitting in the south direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b715f9290c997dd642115fd9c8cd2393a6b559cbf71648be2ef97a2660cbf6d.png] 

From the diagram we can see that **H is facing in north-west direction.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 2.**
